svg.title: How a request moves through the AI Gateway
svg.desc: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, agents and end users call models through the AI Gateway and tools through the MCP Gateway. A model request passes SSO, rate limits, guardrails, the cache and routing, then goes to Azure AI Foundry or Anthropic; a request that fails the guardrails goes no further, and one the cache can answer never reaches a model. Tool calls pass OAuth and the registry of approved servers on the MCP Gateway, then reach the MCP servers. Every call through either gateway, passed or refused, is written to the audit log.
